question:
Select the letter-cluster from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

RSXE, VNBI, ZIFM, ? , HYNU
solution:
The pattern followed here is,

Logic: Addition of (4) in the first, third and fourth letter and subtraction of (5) from the second letter.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/421e734383408badb75d2b8aaa1a0c883affc0ff3f0c7aeb43e05067efecbebd.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "DDJQ".
